symptom: An eight-shot C0 media stage takes 487.489 seconds; shots seven and eight wait locally about 150 seconds.
direct_cause: The shared default admits six tasks while the existing selectable bound is eight; the slowest task starts in the second group.
class_root: The default batch policy underfills the existing eight-slot capacity for independent work without a saved preference.
affected_population: New or preference-free canvas batch users with more than six independent nodes
internal_only_reason: Concurrency eight is an existing Nomi option, not an upstream recommendation. APIMart does not publish a general concurrent-task cap in the checked docs; no vendor guarantee is claimed.
invariants: Absent preference uses the existing eight-slot bound; explicit lower preferences and dependency waves remain authoritative.
generality_proof: UI preference loading, normalization and cost estimation share DEFAULT_CANVAS_BATCH_CONCURRENCY; the unchanged worker still enforces normalized bounds across media kinds.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own the absent-preference batch admission policy.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Initial production state reads the shared preference helper.
Worker count consumes normalizeCanvasBatchConcurrency; by-plan calls preserve serial dependency waves.

recurrence.reason: Every preference-free batch larger than six can incur the same extra local waiting.
same_class_scan: rg DEFAULT_CANVAS_BATCH_CONCURRENCY src: preference, runner, spend estimate share the owner

prevention.invariant: Fill the existing bounded capacity by default while preserving explicit limits.
prevention.failure_mode: Invalid numeric input normalizes to the bounded default; finite inputs remain clamped 1..8.
prevention.strategy: Change the existing shared default instead of adding caller-specific overrides or a second scheduler.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replace the constant in place; no alternative worker or preference path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: This is a local admission-policy value, not a third-party runtime behavior change.

migration: No persisted preference is overwritten, including six. Preference-free sessions use eight.
residual_risks: No paid media rerun: replay measures client scheduling only. Real supplier queueing and rate limits can reduce or erase improvement.
Eight in-flight tasks reduce the window to cancel not-yet-submitted work compared with six.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Shared preference policy is tested alongside actual batch admission and existing cancellation/dependency tests.
